quote.text: Stop whatever you’re doing for a moment and ask yourself: Am I afraid of death because I won’t be able to do this anymore?
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embracing the awareness of life's impermanence helps you savor every precious moment with your children, reinforcing that the time you share is irreplaceable.
    • By confronting the fear that life might someday be cut short, you model resilience and intentional living, teaching your kids to value meaningful relationships over trivial pursuits.
  • Leadership
    • When leaders reflect on the transient nature of all things, they are motivated to make decisions that have lasting, principled impact rather than chasing short-term gains.
    • Acknowledging our mortality cultivates humility and authenticity, encouraging you to inspire your team with a sense of purpose that transcends everyday tasks.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, recognizing that time is finite can drive you to prioritize initiatives that offer enduring value, ensuring that every project contributes meaningfully to users' lives.
    • This perspective urges you to focus on long-term impact rather than quick wins, fostering innovation strategies that are deeply aligned with both customer needs and your core values.
